items.title: Enterprise Grade Home Lab
items.description: A fully virtualized enterprise-style home lab designed to simulate real-world network environments for security testing and research. Built with segmented networks, Active Directory, SIEM integration, and monitoring tools, this lab enables hands-on practice in threat detection, incident response, lateral movement, and privilege escalation across Windows and Linux systems.

items.title: Rubber Ducky / Bad USB
items.description: A custom-built Bad USB project leveraging keystroke injection techniques to simulate real-world attack scenarios. Used for developing and testing payloads that automate exploitation, credential harvesting, and system compromise, this project demonstrates practical understanding of physical attack vectors and endpoint security weaknesses.

items.title: Bad Wifi Audit
items.description: A wireless assessment project built to study Wi-Fi attack surfaces, identify insecure configurations, and simulate realistic audit scenarios involving rogue infrastructure, packet capture, and user-impact testing.

items.title: div:ide Cyber Drill Platform
items.description: A Proxmox-backed cyber drill platform for managing repeatable red-team and blue-team exercises, scenarios, telemetry, and operational reporting.

items.title: Web Vulnerability Scanner
items.description: A modular Python scanner for authorized web assessments, covering discovery, common vulnerability checks, session handling, and report generation.

items.title: Security Tooling Collection
items.description: A collection of focused Python tools for SIEM-style log analysis, phishing triage, packet analysis, port discovery, and password auditing.

items.title: divideCTF Recipe Challenge
items.description: A public web challenge combining a static frontend, Cloudflare Pages Functions, API behavior, and a client-side access-control lesson.

items.title: BABY-C2 Detection Study
items.description: An authorized lab research project examining command-channel abuse, packaging trade-offs, and defensive visibility in a controlled environment.
